description: This file defines constants and functions related to service labels, names, and descriptions for the OpenClaw gateway and node components, including profile normalization and resolution functions.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayProfile
methods.description: Normalizes a gateway profile string by trimming and handling default values.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProfileSuffix
methods.description: Returns a suffix for gateway profile names, prefixed with a hyphen if profile is specified.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Resolves the launch agent label for a given gateway profile.

methods.name: resolveLegacyGatewayLaunchAgentLabels
methods.description: Returns an empty array for legacy gateway launch agent labels.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySystemdServiceName
methods.description: Resolves the systemd service name for a gateway profile.

methods.name: resolveGatewayWindowsTaskName
methods.description: Resolves the Windows task name for a gateway profile.

methods.name: formatGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Formats a description string for the gateway service, including profile and version.

methods.name: resolveGatewayServiceDescription
methods.description: Resolves the description for the gateway service, using environment variables and optional description.

methods.name: resolveNodeLaunchAgentLabel
methods.description: Returns the node launch agent label.

methods.name: resolveNodeSystemdServiceName
methods.description: Returns the systemd service name for the node.

methods.name: resolveNodeWindowsTaskName
methods.description: Returns the Windows task name for the node.

methods.name: formatNodeServiceDescription
methods.description: Formats a description string for the node service, including version.
